boundary: Condition-aware human semantic review, not independent blinded annotation, exhaustive semantic proof, or causal mediation. Existing numeric/score verification is separate. No new threshold, seeds, rescue runs or gate changes.
questions: Did the report change the stated next intervention, and did actual accepted code implement it? Rationale alone is not implementation.
Did numeric features respect query availability, and did references concern a component or the full retained pipeline?
Was a new predictive output produced, or merely a new program/submission with unchanged prediction bytes?
Did any corrected-report gain exceed no-report A, rather than only unaligned-report B?
Did timeouts, rollback, format failures or no effective modification prevent the proposed action? All remain in denominator.
scope: All assigned trajectories; only after service and all trajectories close. Credential-first semantic inspection. No labels or raw predictions are exported.
